operations.description: This API is used to check whether the current region is eligible for setting up a landing zone.
This API is used to create an account in a registered OU of an organization.
This API is used to check the governance maturity in eight domains.
This API is used to create an OU in an organization via RGC. The OU will be automatically registered in RGC.
This API is used to create an RFS template.
This API is used to delete a landing zone.
This API is used to delete a registered OU from an organization.
This API is used to delete an RFS template.
This API is used to deregister an OU in an organization from RGC.
This API is used to disable a governance policy from an OU in an organization.
This API is used to enable a governance policy for an OU in an organization.
This API is used to enroll an organization account in RGC.
This API is used to query the compliance of Config rules of an enrolled account.
This API is used to list all non-compliant resources in an organization.
This API is used to list all preset governance policies of RGC.
This API is used to list all governance policies enabled for an enrolled account in an organization.
This API is used to list all governance policies enabled for a registered OU in an organization.
This API is used to list all drift details of the landing zone.
This API is used to list all enabled governance policies in an organization.
This API is used to query the compliance of the external Config rules for enrolled accounts.
This API is used to list enrolled accounts for which governance policies are enabled.
This API is used to list all enrolled accounts in a registered OU of an organization.
This API is used to list registered OUs that governance policies have been enabled for.
This API is used to query operations on registered OUs and enrolled accounts in RGC.
This API is used to query a list of predefined templates.
This API is used to re-register an OU in an organization with RGC.
This API is used to register an OU in an organization with RGC.
This API is used to create or update a landing zone in the current region.
This API is used to check whether the landing zone needs to be updated.
This API is used to query details about the governance maturity account.
This API is used to query the details of the latest successful governance maturity check.
This API is used to query the overview of the latest successful governance maturity check results.
This API is used to query the status of the latest governance maturity check.
This API is used to query the compliance status of resources in an enrolled account in an organization.
This API is used to query the compliance status of resources in all enrolled accounts in a registered OU in an organization.
This API is used to query details about a preset governance policy.
This API is used to query the operating status by operation ID.
This API is used to query details about a governance policy enabled for an enrolled account in an organization.
This API is used to query details about a governance policy enabled for a registered OU in an organization.
This API is used to query the home region of the landing zone.
This API is used to query all configurations of the current landing zone.
This API is used to query the information about IAM Identity Center users.
This API is used to query the status of landing zone setup.
This API is used to query an organization account that is enrolled by RGC.
This API is used to query the template information of an enrolled account in an organization.
This API is used to list all enrolled core accounts in an organization.
This API is used to query information about OUs registered with RGC.
This API is used to query the registration and deregistration information in RGC.
This API is used to query the parameters for deploying templates.
This API is used to cancel the RGC management of an organization account.
This API is used to update an organization account enrolled by RGC.
